title: Elephentity project specification
description: Settings true of the whole project. Deliberately shallow: it may not declare patterns, fields or anything else an entity would, because reading an entity spec must tell you what that entity has.

driver.description: The one storage backend this project uses. A unit of work has one adaptor, so this cannot vary by entity.

tablePrefix.description: Prepended to every entity's table. Stacks with any prefix the driver adds of its own — under WordPress the real table is $wpdb->prefix, then this, then the entity's table.
